summaries.sse-backend-search: Senior Software Engineer - Backend & Search (Track A) with 3.5+ years of experience and expertise in Go, Python, high-throughput distributed systems, and search/analytical data technologies. Engineered a Go-based observability CLI at Turbot HQ processing 1,000+ logs per second and optimized PostgreSQL queries cutting audit-query time 40%, while owning release engineering across four open-source products (9,300+ GitHub stars).

work.name: Turbot HQ, Inc.
highlights: Engineered core features for Tailpipe, a Go-based observability CLI on DuckDB (a columnar analytical engine) + Parquet, lifting log-processing throughput 30% to 1,000+ logs per second by chunking and batching file reads and streaming writes; reduced memory use to eliminate out-of-memory failures at scale.

Designed and developed an internal REST API microservice in Go using the Gin framework as part of a greenfield build of Turbot Guardrails, a cloud-native SaaS platform; secured endpoints with OAuth 2.0 authentication via Auth0, containerized with Docker, deployed to AWS EC2, and served as a gRPC client for several internal high-throughput microservices.

Built a Kafka-based, fault-tolerant, event-driven distributed pipeline where consumers asynchronously processed policy-enforcement events; added a dead-letter queue (DLQ) for reliable failure handling and reprocessing.

Optimized complex PostgreSQL queries powering customer compliance audits — rewriting AWS IAM policy-evaluation queries with jsonb array elements and multi-stage CTEs — improving query performance 40% and eliminating a class of false-positive findings.

Owned release engineering end-to-end for four open-source Go CLIs (Steampipe, Powerpipe, Flowpipe, Tailpipe) — unified GitHub Actions CI/CD workflows, automated Slack release notifications, and GHCR Docker image tagging — establishing engineering best practices across the platform.
Resolved a production incident by diagnosing a Go service stuck in a Kubernetes CrashLoopBackOff — investigating pod logs and status and collaborating with the platform team to restore service.
Mentored teammates on adopting AI-assisted engineering tools (Claude Code, Cursor) into their daily workflows.
